class.name: SubdivisionBuilder
class.brief_description: Builds the refined meshes of a Catmull-Clark subdivision surface from a welded cage.
class.description: Refines a cage split over several meshes ("owners", such as a character's head and body) as one welded surface, with OpenSubdiv's Catmull-Clark at Blender's settings (edge-only boundary interpolation, face-varying values linear at boundaries, uniform creases, Catmull-Clark triangles), and returns each owner's refined mesh. Each mesh holds the refined faces of its owner's surfaces with their rest pose, and a subdivision payload per surface: the owner's cage with its skin and blend shape deltas, the ghost cage vertices of the other owners its stencils reach, the vertex stencils, and the adjacency a runtime pass needs to recompute normals and tangents. The mesh keeps its blend shape names; its surfaces carry no blend shape arrays. Every glTF vertex of a cage vertex must carry the same position, skin and blend shape deltas; a blend shape that moves an owner's cage or ghost vertices must exist on that owner; and the blend shapes that move a cage vertex two owners hold must come in the same relative order in both owners' lists, so that both sides of a seam sum their deltas to the same bits. A skinned cage of several owners needs each owner's bone names ([method set_owner_bone_names]): the skin is compared by joint name, and a ghost's bones are written in its receiving owner's bind indices. [method build] fails and names what failed otherwise.

method.name: add_face_varying_layer
method.description: Adds a face-varying layer: the value of each weld group, in the source's UV space with [code]v[/code] up. The refined values are stored as [code]1 - v[/code], as glTF stores UVs, in [param array_slot]: [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2], or [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0] as two floats. Returns the layer's index, or [code]-1[/code] on an error.

method.name: add_surface
method.description: Adds a surface of [param owner] (0 to 31): its [param arrays] and [param blend_arrays] as an [ImporterMesh] holds them, its blend shape names, the welded cage vertex of each of its vertices, its cage faces as 4 of its vertex indices each from the face's start corner (with [code]-1[/code] as a triangle's fourth), and per face-varying layer the weld group of each face corner ([code]-1[/code] for a triangle's fourth). A UV or custom array is replaced by the face-varying layer in its slot; normals and tangents are recomputed; colours are refined bilinearly. Returns the surface's index.

method.name: build
method.description: Refines the cage uniformly to [param level] and builds every owner's mesh.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every layer, surface and result.

method.name: get_owner_bone_names
method.description: Returns the bone names set for [param owner] with [method set_owner_bone_names], empty if none.

method.name: get_owner_mesh
method.description: Returns [param owner]'s refined mesh after a successful [method build].

method.name: get_report
method.description: Returns the last build's counts, sizes and timings, with one entry per owner under [code]"owners"[/code].

method.name: set_owner_bone_names
method.description: Sets [param owner]'s skin joint names by bind index (a [Skin]'s bind names, or a glTF skin's joint node names in its joint order). Required for every owner of a skinned cage of several owners, and then used for all of them: the skin is gathered by joint name, and each owner's payload holds its ghosts' bones as its own bind indices. [method build] fails when a ghost is weighted to a joint its receiving owner lacks.

members.member: The blend shape mode of the built meshes. glTF's is [constant Mesh.BLEND_SHAPE_MODE_NORMALIZED].
The welded cage's vertex count, every owner together.
